create_rotation_mapping: create a RotationMapping dataclass to describe transformer architecture module paths for Hadamard rotation
register_mapping: register a RotationMapping under a model type key in the MAPPING_REGISTRY dictionary
get_mapping: get a RotationMapping by key from the registry falling back to a default LLaMA-like mapping
infer_mapping_from_model: infer the best RotationMapping for a model by checking config model_type or class name
list_registered_mappings: list all registered model type keys and their RotationMapping entries in MAPPING_REGISTRY
